context:
Goal: know what you need to plan for as more of your work becomes 3D.
Problem (goal): we have no view of which 3D and engine tools Claude can drive, or what they need.
Based on (read): claude-settings has no 3D or engine skill or MCP today; step web-design-guidelines covers only browser 3D design.
Departs from: main (no 3D tool survey) — adds a ranked survey of 3D and engine MCPs and the things to plan for.

Asked and answered in chat with triage. Your words, Nov 1 12:24 CST: "spawn another opus session that looks at 3d and engine mcps (unity/blender/adobe/everything) to determine as we start doing more 3d what i may need to start thinking about". Filed as roadmap step 3d-tools-survey.

lastAnswer.note: spawn another opus session that looks at 3d and engine mcps

options.gain: A ranked list of tools, their needs, and what to plan for, before 3D work grows.
options.how: The lane researches Unity, Blender, Adobe and other 3D tools Claude can drive, and lists what to plan for.
options.label: Send an Opus lane to survey 3D and engine MCPs
options.lose: An Opus lane costs more than Sonnet.

title: Should an Opus lane survey 3D and game-engine MCP servers?
